name: San Miguel del Arroyo (Spain)
description: Seven horizontal wavy stripes alternating white and blue.
history: The designs of the municipal arms and flag were officially approved on 6 April 2001; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of a white cloth with seven equal horizontal wavy stripes, four white and three blue alternating, each a seventh of the width.

features.role: three blue wavy stripes alternating with four white
